purpose: Pre-registered expansion plan for the KANSOKU paper diagnosis ablation. Planned scenarios are promoted into active ground truth only after live fault-injection validation on the dedicated Ubuntu evaluation host.

normal.promotion_gate: already satisfied by saved v0.10.0 artifact

firewall-deny.fault_model: specific deny rule precedes the normal TCP/443 allow rule

fault_injection.summary: Insert an explicit deny for the target flow at the beginning of fw1 forward chain.
commands: nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.20.20.10 tcp dport 443 counter drop

firewall-deny.promotion_gate: already satisfied by saved v0.10.0 artifact

firewall-subnet-deny.fault_model: source-subnet deny covers the target client while being broader than a host-specific rule

fault_injection.summary: Insert a source-subnet deny for TCP/443 before the normal allow rule.
commands: nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 10.10.10.0/25 tcp dport 443 counter drop

firewall-subnet-deny.promotion_gate: live injection must fail target HTTP and imported nftables state must preserve the subnet predicate

firewall-port-range-deny.fault_model: port-range deny includes the target destination port 443

fault_injection.summary: Insert a TCP destination-port range deny that contains port 443.
commands: nft insert rule inet filter forward tcp dport 400-500 counter drop

firewall-port-range-deny.promotion_gate: live nftables JSON import must normalize the range and the target flow must match it

firewall-rule-order.fault_model: broad deny shadows the later specific TCP/443 allow rule

fault_injection.summary: Insert a broad client-to-server deny ahead of the existing specific allow rule to exercise chain order.
commands: nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.20.20.0/24 counter drop

ground_truth.element_semantics: first effective denying rule in chain evaluation order

firewall-rule-order.promotion_gate: imported policy priority must preserve nftables chain sequence and identify the shadowing deny

route-missing.fault_model: required destination route removed from r1

fault_injection.summary: Remove the static route for 10.20.20.0/24 from r1.

route-missing.promotion_gate: already satisfied by saved v0.10.0 artifact

route-unreachable-next-hop.fault_model: static route points to an unreachable next hop and is expected not to become an installed usable route

fault_injection.summary: Replace the healthy static route with a route through an unreachable next hop.

ground_truth.element_semantics: unusable static route caused by unresolved next hop

route-unreachable-next-hop.promotion_gate: confirm with live FRR JSON whether the route is absent/uninstalled; if FRR reports it installed, reclassify as a boundary case

route-wrong-interface.fault_model: destination prefix is installed toward the wrong output interface

fault_injection.summary: Replace the healthy next-hop route with an interface route toward eth1, the firewall-facing side.
commands: vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'no ip route 10.20.20.0/24 172.16.1.2' -c 'ip route 10.20.20.0/24 eth1'

ground_truth.element_semantics: installed route with incorrect output interface

route-wrong-interface.promotion_gate: retain even if Proposed fails; validates the boundary that v0.10.0 does not verify next-hop/interface reachability

route-blackhole-host.fault_model: more-specific blackhole host route overrides the otherwise healthy destination subnet route

fault_injection.summary: Add a /32 blackhole route for the target server while leaving the healthy /24 route present.

route-blackhole-host.promotion_gate: confirm FRR JSON and parser representation of blackhole routes before final expected-method labels are frozen

vlan-mismatch.fault_model: known-good observed VLAN 10 followed by complete sw1 drift to VLAN 30

fault_injection.summary: Capture a known-good VLAN 10 target flow, then change sw1 access and trunk state to VLAN 30.

vlan-mismatch.promotion_gate: already satisfied by saved v0.10.0 artifact

vlan-access-only-drift.fault_model: access port moves from VLAN 10 to VLAN 30 while the trunk still advertises VLAN 10

fault_injection.summary: Capture known-good VLAN 10, then move only sw1 eth1 access VLAN to 30.

vlan-access-only-drift.promotion_gate: retain as a negative-control boundary case; current correlation checks VLAN existence, not per-port path continuity

vlan-trunk-only-drift.fault_model: trunk stops carrying VLAN 10 while the access port remains assigned to VLAN 10

fault_injection.summary: Capture known-good VLAN 10, then change only sw1 eth2 trunk allowance to VLAN 30.

vlan-trunk-only-drift.promotion_gate: retain as a negative-control boundary case; current correlation checks VLAN existence, not per-port path continuity

compound-route-firewall.fault_model: route missing and explicit firewall deny are active simultaneously

fault_injection.summary: Combine route-missing and firewall-deny after both single-fault families are stable.

compound-route-firewall.promotion_gate: implement multi-causal ground truth and partial-credit evaluation before activation

compound-vlan-firewall.fault_model: complete VLAN drift and explicit firewall deny are active simultaneously

fault_injection.summary: Combine vlan-mismatch and firewall-deny after both single-fault families are stable.

compound-vlan-firewall.flow_observation_phase: pre-drift known-good flow plus post-drift/deny configuration state
compound-vlan-firewall.promotion_gate: implement multi-causal ground truth and partial-credit evaluation before activation
